text: Hara ɗii sanamuuji mon hino mari : koyɗe ko ɗi yahra huntugol haaju mon? Kaa hiɗi mari juuɗe ko ɗi duñirana bone on e doole? Kaa hiɗi mari gite ko ɗi yi'ira kon ko suuɗii on sakko ɗi humpita on? Kaa hiɗi mari noppi ko ɗi nanira kon ko laawii on sakko ɗi hewtinano on ɗum? Si tawii hiɗi ƴellitii e ɗum ɗon fow, ko honno rewirton ɗi fii pooɗugol nafa maa pottingol lorra?! Maakan ɓee sirkooɓe -an Nulaaɗo- : "Noddee ɗii ɗi kafiduɗon e Alla, refti fewjanon lam, wata on nennitanam".
